label: r3c2
name: Conv head plus layout-free residual
hypothesis: This world may not match its description, for example in action-index layout or DONE position. If so, conv heads would map logits to the wrong actions. This adds a zero-initialised dense Linear over flattened conv features to all n_actions logits (DONE included). It can fix any index mismatch, and the conv prior is kept where the layout is right. Recipe: orthogonal init, 2 epochs, lr 2e-3. Refuted if both seeds stay at 0.
